explanation: Bernoulli form is y'+p(x)y=q(x)y^n. Dividing I by y² gives y'-xy³=y², which has two nonlinear powers instead of the required linear term. Dividing II by y gives y'-xy^(-1/2)=x²y^(-1), also with two nonlinear powers. III contains ln(y), which is not a fixed power of y. Therefore, none is Bernoulli.

answers.correct_value: None of the given equations is a Bernoulli differential equation
